value.rationale: The problem is motivated by minimal redundant (two-channel) acquisition with a fixed half-cycle rectangular sensor. The theorem identifies a unique optimal power allocation, every admissible channel gap, sharp upper and lower frame bounds, a rare exact tight exception, and a parity-dependent m-squared unavoidable noise-amplification penalty. These are nontrivial all-integer optimal design and instability boundaries beyond the already known Fourier diagonalization.
